entities.summary: Elisabeth "Eli" Maragall Verge is a former field hockey player from Spain. She was a member of the Women's National Team that won the gold medal at the 1992 Summer Olympics on home soil (Barcelona). Elisabeth Maragall was a athletes & competitors from Barcelona (b. 1970-11-25, Barcelona). A moderately significant entity in the historical record. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
